obstacles.name: Rising Caramel Lava
obstacles.behavior: Bubbling golden-orange molten caramel rises steadily in the survival pit; in advanced chapters, lava geysers bubble onto bottom-row board tiles if left unchecked for 3 moves.
obstacles.clearCondition: Cooled into walkable sugar-crust by matching Coconut/Kulfi candies, activating Ice Cannons, or using Tender Coconut Extinguisher.
obstacles.combinatorics: Pairs with Collapsing Bridges and Fire Barriers to create vertical urgency.
obstacles.visualConcept: Glossy amber-crimson bubbling fluid with warm subsurface glow and floating sugar-spark embers.

obstacles.name: Rolling Spiked Jawbreaker
obstacles.behavior: Massive layered candy boulder studded with sugar-crystal spikes rolling down sloped orchard/foothill tracks behind Mochi.
obstacles.clearCondition: Slowed by Rasgulla Bounce Pads, halted by raised mechanical gates, or shattered by 3 Special Candy blasts.
obstacles.combinatorics: Combines with Rotating Gates and Crumbling Platforms on downhill chase stages.
obstacles.visualConcept: Swirling magenta-and-ivory jawbreaker sphere with faceted crystalline studs.

obstacles.name: Himalayan Frost Ice
obstacles.behavior: Encases candies or exit chutes in 1-to-2 layers of translucent alpine ice, preventing tile movement until thawed.
obstacles.clearCondition: Cracked by matching the candy inside (if 1-layer translucent) or matching orthogonally adjacent candies / Striped lasers.
obstacles.combinatorics: Protects Golden Keys and Brass Trunks from premature collection.
obstacles.visualConcept: Refractive sapphire-cyan crystal block with internal frost ferns and crisp specular shatter.

obstacles.name: Woven Bamboo Crate Cage
obstacles.behavior: Sturdy criss-crossed Bengal bamboo crate occupying a board cell and blocking vertical candy/marble gravity above drain chutes.
obstacles.clearCondition: Damaged by adjacent matches, Jackfruit heavy-match shockwaves (+1 bonus damage), Hammer, or Bomb blasts.
obstacles.combinatorics: Forms diagonal waterfall funnels when staggered with Coconut Husk Bumpers.
obstacles.visualConcept: Warm honey-golden split bamboo lattice lashed with natural twine.

obstacles.name: Forged Iron Padlock Chain
obstacles.behavior: Crossed metallic links locking a candy in place so it cannot be swapped or fall, though its color can still participate in matches.
obstacles.clearCondition: Include the chained candy in a 3+ match, hit with any Special blast, or snap via Riverboat Winch tension.
obstacles.combinatorics: Locks Special Candies or Keys mid-board as high-value rewards once freed.
obstacles.visualConcept: Brushed pewter-steel links with a gleaming brass padlock medallion.

obstacles.name: Sticky Tree-Sap Slime
obstacles.behavior: Viscous lime-amber gummy ooze spat by serpents or oozing from slime blobs; prevents swapping and spreads 1 tile every 3 turns if none are cleared.
obstacles.clearCondition: Cleared by matching with the coated candy, Coconut Splash combos, or Monsoon Water Blaster.
obstacles.combinatorics: Synergizes dangerously with Tea Mist Clouds that hide where slime is about to spread.
obstacles.visualConcept: Translucent bouncy lime jelly dome with playful rising air bubbles.

obstacles.name: Falling Wafer Platform
obstacles.behavior: Crispy butter-biscuit ledges under Mochi that crack stage-by-stage every 10 seconds (or 3 moves) before dropping into the chasm.
obstacles.clearCondition: Advance Mochi to the next safe ledge via objective matches, or clamp with Golden Resin Platform Anchor.
obstacles.combinatorics: Pairs with Jute Grapple Rope and Timed Escape Doors.
obstacles.visualConcept: Layered golden tea-biscuit slab shedding harmless sugar crumbs as its stability meter ticks down.

obstacles.name: Moving Terracotta Partition
obstacles.behavior: Indestructible 2-tile terracotta slider bar that shifts 1 column left or right after every move, dynamically opening and closing drain chutes!
obstacles.clearCondition: Not destroyed—outsmarted by timing matches when the chute aligns, or temporarily pinned with Resin Anchor.
obstacles.combinatorics: Forces rhythmic planning on Key-drop and Marble-drain boards.
obstacles.visualConcept: Carved warm Bengal terracotta brick block inlaid with geometric floral patterns.

obstacles.name: Collapsing Suspension Bridge
obstacles.behavior: Multi-plank wooden bridge across canyon/river gaps whose slats snap one by one under enemy pursuit or monsoon gusts.
obstacles.clearCondition: Rebuilt plank-by-plank by matching Guava/Jackfruit structural candies on the board.
obstacles.combinatorics: Combines with Gale Wind Tunnels and Mangrove Root Crawlers.
obstacles.visualConcept: Curved bamboo-and-plank walkway swaying gently on braided ropes.

obstacles.name: Sticky Sundarbans Mud Bog
obstacles.behavior: 100% poison-free, comical chocolaty silt bog! Slows Mochi's movement speed by 50% in the arena and swallows falling board items unless paved over with leaf-mats.
obstacles.clearCondition: Flushed clean by Monsoon Water Blaster, Daab Coconut matches, or bridged with Mango Nectar slicks.
obstacles.combinatorics: Slows Mochi while Mangrove Root Crawlers close distance.
obstacles.visualConcept: Glossy cocoa-brown mud puddles popping playful round mud-bubbles.

obstacles.name: Monsoon River Floodwater
obstacles.behavior: Submerges the bottom 2–3 rows of the puzzle board in sparkling river water! Submerged candies float UPWARD instead of falling downward when matched, inverting cascade physics!
obstacles.clearCondition: Lowered by matching pump-valve candies or cranking Sluice Floodgates.
obstacles.combinatorics: Creates mind-bending dual-gravity boards where top rows fall down and bottom rows float up!
obstacles.visualConcept: Crystal-clear aquamarine water volume with gentle surface ripples and floating lotus petals.

obstacles.name: Spiced Sugar Fire Barrier
obstacles.behavior: Crackling warm cinnamon-chili flame ring around board tiles; spreads 1 adjacent tile if no fire tile is extinguished on a turn. Destroys normal candies it overtakes (never Keys).
obstacles.clearCondition: Extinguished by adjacent Jamun/Coconut matches, Freeze Blast, or Tender Coconut Extinguisher.
obstacles.combinatorics: Avoid using Gust Fan while Fire is active unless extinguished first!
obstacles.visualConcept: Stylized cartoon tangerine-and-gold flame crown dancing over sizzling sugar.

obstacles.name: Rotating Tea-Mill Gate
obstacles.behavior: 4-blade wooden paddle turnstile that rotates 90 degrees after every move, alternating between blocking horizontal matches vs blocking vertical drops—and toggling Mochi's upper tunnel gate in sync!
obstacles.clearCondition: Controlled via move cadence, Riverboat Winch, or Resin Anchor.
obstacles.combinatorics: Turns move counting into a puzzle rhythm game.
obstacles.visualConcept: Polished teakwood mill wheel with brass hub rivets.

obstacles.name: Sugar-Mill Piston Crusher
obstacles.behavior: Heavy brass press that glows amber to telegraph 1 turn ahead, then slams down—compressing an arena corridor or crushing unprotected Special Candies in its target column!
obstacles.clearCondition: Jammed for 3 turns by hitting its gear-switch tile with a Striped/Wrapped blast, or absorbed by Rasgulla Orbs.
obstacles.combinatorics: Punishes hoarding Special Candies in telegraphed danger columns.
obstacles.visualConcept: Steampunk-lite brass confectioner's press with striped hazard trim.

obstacles.name: Alternating Bamboo Thorn Plate
obstacles.behavior: Floor panels along Mochi's escape corridor whose blunt cartoon thorn-pegs pop UP on odd moves and retract DOWN on even moves.
obstacles.clearCondition: Advance Mochi only on safe 'even' beats, shield her with Sugar Shield, or bounce over with Rasgulla Trampoline.
obstacles.combinatorics: Adds turn-synchronization tension to Key unlocks.
obstacles.visualConcept: Checkered sandstone floor tile with bright coral-tipped bamboo pegs.

obstacles.name: Locked Brass Sweet Trunk
obstacles.behavior: Ornate locked market chest sitting on the board with 3 colored gem-locks (e.g., 1 Mango, 1 Litchi, 1 Jamun); immune to generic hammers until its matching fruit colors are matched nearby!
obstacles.clearCondition: Match the displayed fruit colors anywhere in the chest's row/column to pop all 3 clasps and release Rescue Parts.
obstacles.combinatorics: Requires targeted color-hunting amidst chaotic hazards.
obstacles.visualConcept: Embossed golden-brass chest with three glowing fruit-shaped keyhole gems.

obstacles.name: Cyclone Wind Current
obstacles.behavior: Breezy wind stream across 2 designated rows that slides all unblocked candies 1 cell sideways at the end of every turn—and pushes Mochi's sailboat/balloon in the arena!
obstacles.clearCondition: Redirected or calmed for 2 turns by Sylhet Bamboo Gust Fan or matching Wind-Vane switches.
obstacles.combinatorics: Auto-creates surprise cascade chains for clever players who anticipate the 1-cell sideways drift!
obstacles.visualConcept: Translucentmint-white swirling slipstream ribbons with fluttering leaves.

obstacles.name: Country-Boat Ferry Gondola
obstacles.behavior: Wooden river sampan carrying Mochi across wide water channels; drifts backward with the current unless propelled forward by matching Blue/Aqua candies.
obstacles.clearCondition: Reach the far pier by accumulating propulsion matches while fending off Whirlpool Eels.
obstacles.combinatorics: Turns the entire board into a tug-of-war propulsion engine.
obstacles.visualConcept: Hand-painted colourful wooden Bengal river boat with a lantern bow.

obstacles.name: Foothill Sugar-Shale Rockfall
obstacles.behavior: Unstable cavern ceiling that drops 2 crunchy rock-candy pebbles into the top board rows (and threatens Mochi's helmet!) whenever a 3x3 Bomb detonates.
obstacles.clearCondition: Pebbles clear with 1 adjacent match; promotes precision Striped/Teleporter play over reckless bombing.
obstacles.combinatorics: Balances explosive power-up spam in Chapter 8 & 10.
obstacles.visualConcept: Faceted amber-grey rock-sugar chunks with dust puffs.

obstacles.name: Counterweight Sluice Shutter
obstacles.behavior: Heavy exit blast door that starts 100% OPEN at level start and ratchets CLOSED by 4% every second! Matching counterweight candies cranks it back up.
obstacles.clearCondition: Keep the shutter >= 35% open at the moment Mochi reaches the exit threshold.
obstacles.combinatorics: Inverts the standard 'unlock closed gate' formula into a 'hold the door open!' thriller.
obstacles.visualConcept: Riveted bronze sluice gate suspended on twin counterweight chains.

obstacles.name: Sylhet Highland Mist Veil
obstacles.behavior: Soft pearlescent valley fog drifting over a 3x3 patch of candies, obscuring their colors (silhouettes faintly peek through!) until cleared.
obstacles.clearCondition: Cleared by any match touching the mist, Mandarin Orange zest burst, Bamboo Gust Fan, or Firefly Beacon.
obstacles.combinatorics: Tests silhouette recognition (which is why each 3D candy has a unique shape!).
obstacles.visualConcept: Volumetric soft silver-mint cloud puffs hovering just above the 3D candies.

obstacles.name: Armored Coconut Husk Bumper
obstacles.behavior: Tough fibrous shell angled at 45 degrees: absorbs 1 HP when hit by a Striped laser AND reflects the remaining laser beam 90 degrees across the perpendicular axis!
obstacles.clearCondition: 3 adjacent matches or 3 laser bank-shots crack the husk open to reveal a bonus Tender Coconut candy.
obstacles.combinatorics: Enables trick-shot laser geometry around indestructible corners!
obstacles.visualConcept: Polished half-coconut bumper with a gleaming angled pearl-shell mirror plate.

obstacles.name: Sundarbans Golden Honeycomb
obstacles.behavior: Connected cluster of 4–7 hexagonal golden wax cells; peripheral cells regenerate 1 HP unless the glowing central 'Queen Drop' cell is cracked first!
obstacles.clearCondition: Focus matches or Hammer/Striped blasts onto the glowing central Queen Wax cell to shatter the entire linked honeycomb at once!
obstacles.combinatorics: Teaches target prioritization instead of random matching.
obstacles.visualConcept: Warm translucent amber honeycomb lattice dripping golden nectar.

obstacles.name: Refracting Quartz Prism
obstacles.behavior: Permanent crystalline node on the board: whenever a Striped blast or Rainbow arc touches it, the prism splits and fires beams in BOTH row and column directions!
obstacles.clearCondition: Beneficial puzzle structure—rotates 45 degrees each turn between Orthogonal (+) and Diagonal (X) beam splitting!
obstacles.combinatorics: Core mechanic of Chapter 10 & the Final Prism Hydra Boss fight!
obstacles.visualConcept: Floating iridescent diamond-cut quartz crystal casting subtle rainbow caustics.
